summary: conversion_batches_onboarding_guard: the approved preflight hash may be replaced only while the batch is in preflight and unposted and the preflight the earlier approval was bound to has been superseded; the replacement still needs a human approval of the current preflight result. The rest of the 485 body is unchanged. No existing row changes.

preflight.name: the guard trigger exists on conversion_batches
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_conversion_batches_onboarding_guard'

preflight.name: the guard is still strictly write-once
preflight.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN pg_get_functiondef('conversion_batches_onboarding_guard()'::regprocedure) LIKE '%after the preflight it approved was superseded%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

expected_changes: No row in any table changes.

verify.name: the guard allows replacing only a superseded approval
verify.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN pg_get_functiondef('conversion_batches_onboarding_guard()'::regprocedure) LIKE '%after the preflight it approved was superseded%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
